name: ALDI Receipt
description:
This receipt is issued under the ALDI brand and displays the store header including “Store #027,” the full street address at 7390 State Route 161 E, Plain City, a customer service phone number (833-461-2027), and the website www.ALDI.us
. The transaction section includes itemized entries with right-aligned pricing, followed by a structured financial summary showing Subtotal, Tax, and Total. A timestamp line appears with internal store and register identifiers (*9117 461/027/004/801 06/13/24 09:51AM), separated by asterisks. The lower section contains a customer feedback promotion directing customers to www.tellaldi.us
 for a gift card drawing, along with an email signup promotion. The payment block documents a VISA transaction with a masked card number, reference/sequence number, trace number, authorization code, AID, TVR, IAD, TSI, ARC, entry mode, and an “++APPROVED++” confirmation, reflecting a standard grocery retail POS thermal receipt format.
